# KunaalNaik.com Implementation Task List

> **For Hermes:** Execute this checklist sequentially. Mark each checkbox only after its verification command passes.

**Goal:** Replace the current one-page brochure with a premium, crawlable personal-brand website for corporate AI training and practical AI workflow consulting, then publish it to GitHub and Vercel.

**Architecture:** Dependency-free static multi-page site generated by one Python stdlib build script. Shared navigation, footer, metadata, schema, CTAs, and design tokens are generated once; each page gets a unique search intent and proof requirements.

**Tech stack:** HTML5, CSS, minimal vanilla JavaScript, Python 3 stdlib build/check scripts, GitHub, Vercel.

**Primary CTA:** `mailto:me@kunaalnaik.com`

**Verified social profiles:**
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kunaal-naik/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/KunaalNaik
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coachkunaal/

## Phase 3 — Technical SEO/AEO

- [x] Generate `sitemap.xml` containing only real canonical URLs.
- [x] Create `robots.txt` with the sitemap and explicit search-crawler policy.
- [x] Create `404.html` and configure Vercel clean URLs/trailing slashes in `vercel.json`.
- [x] Add `Person`, `ProfilePage`, `Organization`, `WebSite`, `Service`, and `WebPage` schema only where accurate.
- [x] Add Open Graph/Twitter metadata and a branded social-preview image.
- [x] Create real privacy and terms pages before linking to them.
- [x] Ensure no placeholder `#` links exist.

**Exit check:** Local checker reports zero broken internal links, zero missing metadata fields, zero duplicate titles, and valid JSON parsing for every schema block.

## Phase 4 — Quality assurance

- [x] Create one dependency-free `check_site.py` smoke test.
- [x] Run build and checker.
- [x] Serve the output locally and inspect desktop/mobile layouts.
- [x] Check browser console for JavaScript errors.
- [x] Verify keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, contrast, and responsive tables/navigation.
- [x] Verify all external and `mailto:` links.

**Commands:**

```bash
python3 build.py
python3 check_site.py
python3 -m http.server 8765
```

**Exit check:** Checks pass and browser inspection shows no blocking defects.
